{{AprilFoolsEnd|date = 2nd of April 2022}} {{AprilFoolsInfobox |image1 = Whatagreatthumbnail.png |dates = 31 March 2022 – 2 April 2022 |previous_edition = [[April Fools 2021|Imposter 2021]] |next_edition = [[April Fools 2023|Translated 2023]] }} ==Description== '''April Fools 2022''' was the third April Fools edition that was added to the game on the 31st of March 2022, and was removed from the game on the 2nd of April 2022. It randomized the faces, animations, and the sounds of towers, units and enemies. Additionally, it also changed the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] narrator's icons and dialogue. The icon and thumbnail was also changed into a poorly drawn version of the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]] icon and thumbnail, while the title was changed multiple times. ==Changes== ===Faces=== The faces of towers, units and enemies were changed into one of the faces below: {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:400px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:ManFace.png|150px]] |[[File:WomanFace.png|150px]] |- |[[w:c:roblox:Catalog:Man Face|Man Face]] |[[w:c:roblox:Catalog:Woman Face|Woman Face]] |} The faces used were unique on each server. In one server, a default [[Scout]] could use the [[w:c:roblox:Catalog:Man_Face|Man Face]], and in another it could use the [[w:c:roblox:Catalog:Woman_Face|Woman Face]]. The face only changes if the tower, unit or enemy has a face. Otherwise, it will remain faceless. This effect can be replicated using the [[April fools 2022 (Modifier)|April fools 2022]] modifier. ===Animations=== The animations of towers, units, enemies and emotes were changed into any random animation used in the game. The animation could be any animation used in the game. Due to most enemies, units and towers using R6 while emotes use R15, if they used the animation of an emote, it would not work properly. Similarly, emotes would not work properly when they used an animation of an enemy, unit or a tower that does not use R15. The animations were unique on each server. Some towers did not have their animations changed. These towers are: *The [[Gladiator]] *The [[Slasher]] *The [[Executioner]] *The [[Farm]], as it has no animations *The [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] **The [[Crook Boss]]'s units were affected by the animation change. *The [[Pursuit]] *The [[Ace Pilot]] *The [[Turret]] **The {{Color|Premium|XR500}} skin for the [[Turret]] was affected by the animation change. This effect can be replicated using the [[April fools 2022 (Modifier)|April fools 2022]] modifier. ===Audio=== The audio of towers, units and enemies were changed into any random audio used in the game. The audio could be any audio used in the game. Towers, units and enemies could use currently unused audio, such as the [[Militant|John]]'s ''Enraging Shout'' ability audio, or audio from exclusive towers, such as the War Machine. Additionally, there were some sounds that were never heard before in the game, added to the game as part of the '''April Fools 2022'''. The audio is unique in each server. While emotes were affected by animation changes, their music did not change. They would play the intended music. This effect can be replicated using the [[April fools 2022 (Modifier)|April fools 2022]] modifier. ===Narration=== The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] narrator was changed for the '''April Fools 2022''' update. Rather than being a Roblox humanoid, it was a white wolf. Additionally, the dialogue in every gamemode was spoken in furry talk, except the lose dialogue. The wave layout was not changed. This effect cannot be replicated using the [[April fools 2022 (Modifier)|April fools 2022]] modifier. A full list of all the dialogue during the '''April Fools 2022''' update can be found here:

===Game Titles=== When the '''April Fools 2022''' update was released, the title of the game has changed multiple times. The list of all the titles are: *(new) tower defense game (wow!!!) *Tower (early) Simulator *Tower (Very early) Simulator *new tower defense simulator update!!! *TOWER EARLY SIMULATOR ==Trivia== *The [[Militant]] and [[Scout]] on the thumbnail for the '''April Fools 2022''' update was a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/two-soyjaks-pointing Two Soyjaks Pointing] meme. *The titles "''Tower (early) Simulator''", "''Tower (Very early) Simulator''" and "''TOWER EARLY SIMULATOR''" are a reference to the "Tower Delay Simulator" meme, which started due to the frequent delays that Tower Defense Simulator updates used to have. The developers updated the game early on the 31st of March instead of the 1st of April to mock the meme. {{EventNavBox}}
